topic: Adjusting VA calculation for one-way roads
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on discrepancies in the calculation of 'VA' (presumably a directional angle or value) when analyzing road data, particularly concerning one-way streets and map directionality. Initially, there were concerns that the displayed VA values seemed incorrect for roads running in certain directions.

It was revealed that the current API logic only zeroes out VA for two-directional roads, which was implemented to align with an older VA algorithm. A proposal was made to modify the API to ensure that VA is zeroed out for *any* road segment when movement originates from a sensor (i.e., regardless of whether it's one-way or two-way).

Participants agreed that calculating VA should be suppressed entirely in cases where the road has a small angle, as this situation was deemed logically inconsistent and potentially an error.
decisions: The API logic for VA calculation needs modification to zero out the value for any road segment when movement originates from a sensor, regardless of whether the road is one-way or two-way.
action_items: Modify the API side to adjust the VA calculation as discussed.
